goal: Fix outbound connection failures when routing through SOCKS5 proxies using Tor to IPv6 peers
Prevents Tor exit relays from dropping connections to IPv6 addresses that contain double colons
agreement: Verified by testing IPv6 peer selection over Tor to resolve SOCKS connection failures (andrewtoth)
Concept approval after confirming the upstream Tor behavior (darosior)
Re-approved after addressing test deduplication feedback (andrewtoth)

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because it fixes closed outbound connection failures to 20 to 29 percent of IPv6 peers over Tor
Restores connectivity to affected peers when using Tor SOCKS5 proxies with no fallback available
